TRADE_ORDER_BELOW_PROFIT_CUTOFF.en: @trigger_fail! No profitable [trade|e] route could be found.\nBest route is [MARKET.GetNameWithNoTooltip] at $PROFIT_RATIO|+=2$@gold! per [merchant_capacity|e] (minimum required is $CUTOFF|=2$@gold!).\nThe AI will keep trying each day.

TRADE_ORDER_CAPACITY_TOOLTIP_SUMMARY.en: This [trade_order|e] is managing to use [TradeOrderItem.GetUsedCapacity|2Y]@trade_capacity! out of the [TradeOrderItem.GetAllocatedCapacity|2Y]@trade_capacity! allocated for [TradeOrderItem.GetGoods.GetName].

TRADE_ORDER_CREATE_IE_TT_EXPORT.en: Allocate [merchant_capacity|e] to [export|e] this good with the best route.

TRADE_ORDER_CREATE_IE_TT_IMPORT.en: Allocate [merchant_capacity|e] to [import|e] this good with the best route.

TRADE_ORDER_CREATE_TT.en: Allocate [merchant_capacity|e] to [import|e] or [export|e] this good with the best route.

TRADE_ORDER_EXPORT_ACTIVE.en: You have an active [export|e] Order for this good.\nThe AI will spend [GetTradeOrderCapacity] [merchant_capacity|e] finding the best destination.

TRADE_ORDER_IMPORT_ACTIVE.en: You have an active [import|e] Order for this good.\nThe AI will spend [GetTradeOrderCapacity] [merchant_capacity|e] finding the best source.

TRADE_ORDER_NO_PROFITABLE_ROUTE.en: @trigger_fail! No profitable [trade|e] could be found. The AI will keep trying each day.

TRADE_ORDER_NO_ROUTES.en: No [trade|e] has been assigned yet. The AI will set one up each day.

TRADE_ORDER_OPEN_TRADES_TAB_DESC.en: Opens the Trades tab for this market with your [trade|e] only, merchant capacity from this market, and the import or export filter matching this [trade_order|e].

TRADE_ORDER_PRIORITY_INFO.en: Orders listed earlier receive [merchant_capacity|e] first when there is not enough to fill all orders.

TRADE_ORDER_QUICK_BUILDING_NEEDS_OPEN.en: Create Trade Order for Building needs

TRADE_ORDER_QUICK_EXPORT_TT.en: Create an [export|e] order with 1 [merchant_capacity|e]. The AI will find the best destination each day.

TRADE_ORDER_QUICK_GOV_NEEDS_OPEN.en: Create Trade Order for Government Needs

TRADE_ORDER_QUICK_IMPORT_TT.en: Create an [import|e] order with 1 [merchant_capacity|e]. The AI will find the best source each day.

TRADE_ORDER_TRADES_SCROLL_LIST_EMPTY.en: There is no [trade|e] in the market for this good. You can manually add one or add a [trade_order|e] to set it for you.
